Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study utilizes two main structural proteomics techniques: HDX-MS and XL-MS. The PRIDE metadata and the detailed methods section specifically describe the XL-MS workflow using DSSO crosslinkers and label-free quantification (LFQ) via DDA on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos. While HDX-MS is described, the primary routing for the provided PRIDE dataset (PXD025728) is for the cross-linking experiment.

scope: The first stage was to isolate highly pure HisSUMO-RORγ by affinity purification
To form RORγ2:RORE complexes, 100 μL of RORE was added to 33 μL of 4X HBS
RORγ2:cRORE was reconstituted and treated with synthetic agonist SR19547 (5-fold molar excess) followed by incubation with recombinant full length SRC3 (1.5-fold molar excess)
The RORγ2:cRORE:SR19547 solution was then diluted with 1:1 with 12 μM SRC3

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a combination of HDX-MS and XL-MS to analyze the conformational changes of RORγ upon binding to different DNA response elements (cRORE vs vRORE), the effect of a synthetic agonist (SR19547), and the subsequent recruitment of the coactivator SRC3.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The XL-MS data used label-free quantitation (LFQ) based on peak areas from MS1 full-scan filtering in Skyline.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Explicit use of DSSO (disuccinimidyl sulfoxide) crosslinker with MS2-MS3 fragmentation strategy for sulfoxide cleavage.
Extensive use of Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange Mass Spectrometry (HDX-MS) to monitor conformational changes.

workflow: RORγ:RORE samples were crosslinked in HBST buffer using disuccinimidyl sulfoxide (DSSO, Cayman chemicals).
Crosslinks were identified using the XlinkX algorithm implemented on Proteome Discoverer (version 2.2).
Doublet pairs of ions with the targeted mass difference for sulfoxide fragmentation (31.9721 Da) with charge states were selected for HCD fragmentation
Peak areas for identified crosslinks were quantified using Skyline (version 19.1)
Typical HDX-MS peptide identification was performed using a previously described automated liquid handling robot coupled to an Agilent 1260 HPLC
differential: Pair-wise comparisons were made using ‘MSstats’ package implemented in the Skyline browser to calculate relative fold changes and significance
Significant changes were defined as log 2 fold change was less than -1 or greater than 1 and -log10 adjusted P-value was greater than 1.3 (P value < 0.05).
search_parameters: Cysteine carbamidylation and methionine oxidation were considered as a fixed and a dynamic modification, respectively.
Crosslinks were considered for lysine, threonine, serine, and tyrosine residues

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The dataset contains two distinct structural proteomics modalities: XL-MS (using DSSO) and HDX-MS. The differential analysis for XL-MS is specifically focused on crosslink abundance (peptide-level) using MSstats.
